links.outcome: Concordance of LLM meal plan nutrient content with reference nutrition databases and nutrition goals
links.effect: All models substantially misrepresented nutrient content, underestimating phosphorus and potassium; ChatGPT performed best, yet none produced clinically acceptable meal plans.
links.quote: All models demonstrated substantial limitations in accurately representing nutrient content, particularly in underestimating phosphorus and potassium content in foods.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM-reported nutrient quantities for hemodialysis meal plans against gold-standard databases
links.effect: All four models misrepresented nutrient content, underestimating phosphorus and potassium; outputs often vague, recommending composite foods without clear nutrient values.
links.quote: All models misrepresented nutrient content and had significant usability concerns.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of several commercial LLMs in generating meal plans for simulated hemodialysis patient profiles without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
